promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Geometry/layout authority and edit target: keep every silhouette, position and size
Image 2: Painting style and rendering finish only; not layout, not material colour
Image 3: Hex reference: the hexagonal armour-plate surface pattern only; not layout, not shapes, not colour

Use case: sketch-to-render, game sprite sheet. Image 1 is the authoritative geometry guide and edit target: reskin it, keeping every shape exactly where and how big it is on the 1536x1024 canvas. It holds two separate objects for a sci-fi strategy-game building prop (like a tabletop miniature terrain set), each seen from directly above. Left: a raised smooth pedestal about one storey (four metres) tall with rounded corners, seen from straight above, so its smooth sloped side walls show as the four bands round the rounded top deck: north and west faces lit, south and east faces in shade; it must read clearly as a tall solid form standing above the ground. A glowing light strip rims the deck, a smooth ramp with light strips runs down the south face (keep it as drawn), round fittings with glowing centres on three deck corners; the deck holds an empty dark circular ring well (leave the well dark and plain: a separate rotating house sits over it). Right: the heavy rotating machinery house that sits on it: a large smooth oval shell with two swept rear fins, a glowing ring on its crown, a flush lens, and one long pipe wound with ring coils and ending in a glowing tip, pointing straight up the image. Material and style: Hard-light field high-tech: pale pearl-grey composite with smooth curves, translucent blue-tinted glass canopies on the housings, and bright pale-blue glowing field-projector rings and emitter nodes where the guide shows the brightest lines and dots, with a faint luminous haze over them; graphite pipes with glowing blue coil rings; luminous, clean, otherworldly. Surface: every composite shell, housing and deck is armoured in a fine regular pattern of small hexagonal ceramic plates with thin dark seams, as on the hex-armoured warship hull in the hex reference image: one continuous honeycomb across each surface, plates a few pixels across at sprite size, slightly crowned, a little paler on lit faces; glass, glowing rings and pipes stay smooth. Straight 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, top-down like a strategy-game map sprite, no perspective tilt. Sun from the upper left: keep the guide's lit and shaded faces exactly where they are. Hand-painted gritty science-fiction game-sprite look like Starsector, restrained palette, coarse readable detail that survives being shrunk to about 30 to 40 pixels per cell. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no ground or terrain, no grass, no cast shadow outside the objects, no extra slab, apron or border. Transparent background outside every silhouette (if transparency is impossible, a flat pure white background). Change only material, surface detail and subtle shading, never placement, size or silhouette.
